# The importer reports counts without the inputs it read

Recorded until the importer learns to attach the inputs it read, and nobody
went back to it: the expiry has passed while the record still says accepted,
which is the expired_deviation warning. The expiry is the deviation's own
field rather than an attribute of the departure, because a record that departs
from two clauses has one lifetime and not two.
